title: Why did the loss become infinite?
prompt: A classifier gives the correct class a score of −1000 and the other class a score of 0. Both scores are finite, but the starter returns infinity. Repair cross_entropy to return the mean cross-entropy across the batch. For scores z and correct class y, the per-row loss is −ln(exp(z[y]) / sum(exp(z[j]))). You may rewrite this formula. Use Python and NumPy. logits is a float64 array with shape (N, C), 1 ≤ N ≤ 128, 2 ≤ C ≤ 256 and scores in [−10000, 10000]. labels is an integer array of shape (N,) with a valid class index for each row. Return one finite scalar. Absolute and relative tolerances are both 1e-6.
